claims.statement: Management declined to provide Q3 guidance but said they are close to breaking prominent names this quarter and will do better on numbers.
IndyAstra has a signed MOU with defence for a project important to national security; details restricted.
Promoters are investing personal money into the company for infrastructure; no dilution planned, further investment intended.

FY 2026–27 represents the Consolidation Year. The Company's focus during this phase is expected to be on strengthening the ecosystem, deepening relationships with OEMs and technology partners, broadening solution capabilities, enhancing organisational and technical capabilities.
claims.value: Strengthening ecosystem, deepening OEM relationships, broadening solution capabilities, enhancing capabilities
